# Test Cases — Team Chat Application

**Artifact:** Test Cases
**Stage:** 4 of 7 (Exercise 2)
**Status:** Final (generated by Claude Opus, critiqued, updated)
**Builds on:** chatapp.assumptions.md, chatapp.requirements.md, chatapp.funcspecs.md

---

## Purpose

This document defines test cases that verify the chat application meets its
requirements and behaves as described in the functional specifications. Each
test case has a unique ID, preconditions, steps, expected results, and a
traceability link to the requirement(s) and feature(s) it validates.

Test types covered:
- **Functional** (F): user-facing behavior
- **Non-Functional** (N): performance, security, observability
- **Negative/Edge** (E): invalid input and error handling

---

## 1. Join & Identity

| ID | Type | Title | Preconditions | Steps | Expected Result | Traces to |
|----|------|-------|---------------|-------|-----------------|-----------|
| TC-01 | F | Join with valid name | App loaded, Join screen visible | Enter "Alice"; click Join | User enters chat room; chat screen shown; "Alice joined" notice broadcast | FR-01, 2.1 |
| TC-02 | E | Reject empty name | Join screen visible | Leave name blank; attempt Join | Join blocked; inline validation shown; Join button disabled | FR-02, BR-01 |
| TC-03 | E | Reject whitespace name | Join screen visible | Enter spaces only; attempt Join | Join blocked; validation shown | FR-02, BR-01 |
| TC-04 | F | Name appears on messages | User "Alice" joined | Send a message | Message shows sender "Alice" and a timestamp | FR-05, BR-04 |

## 2. Messaging

| ID | Type | Title | Preconditions | Steps | Expected Result | Traces to |
|----|------|-------|---------------|-------|-----------------|-----------|
| TC-05 | F | Send and broadcast | Alice and Bob both joined | Alice sends "Hello" | Bob receives "Hello" with Alice + timestamp within ~1s | FR-03, FR-04, NFR-01 |
| TC-06 | F | Own message echo | Alice joined | Alice sends a message | Alice sees her own message, visually distinguished | FR-04, 2.2 |
| TC-07 | E | Ignore empty message | Alice joined | Click Send with empty input | Nothing is sent; no message row added | FR-10, BR-03 |
| TC-08 | E | Ignore whitespace message | Alice joined | Enter spaces; Send | Nothing is sent | FR-10, BR-03 |
| TC-09 | E | Reject over-length message | Alice joined | Enter > 2000 chars; Send | Rejected with inline validation; not broadcast | FR-09, BR-02 |
| TC-10 | F | Input cleared after send | Alice joined | Send a valid message | Input field is cleared and focused | 2.2, 3.2 |
